<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="heroShade" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#242424" stop-opacity="0.12"/>
      <stop offset="58%" stop-color="#242424" stop-opacity="0.42"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#050505" stop-opacity="0.98"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="coffeeBg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8D5135"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#C67C4E"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5A3025"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cupFill" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F9F2ED"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#D8B39A"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#242424"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="792" fill="url(#coffeeBg)"/>

  <!-- coffee image placeholder / still life -->
  <rect x="18" y="92" width="354" height="500" rx="24" fill="#9B5F40" opacity="0.38"/>

  <circle cx="313" cy="152" r="28" fill="#FBBE21" opacity="0.25"/>
  <polygon points="26,468 118,350 176,417 230,330 368,492 368,574 26,574" fill="#5A3025" opacity="0.62"/>
  <polygon points="26,500 133,404 190,463 242,388 368,527 368,574 26,574" fill="#3A2522" opacity="0.72"/>
  <circle cx="92" cy="214" r="10" fill="#F9F2ED" opacity="0.25"/>
  <circle cx="119" cy="238" r="6" fill="#F9F2ED" opacity="0.2"/>
  <circle cx="265" cy="272" r="34" fill="#4A281F" opacity="0.75"/>
  <ellipse cx="265" cy="271" rx="22" ry="12" fill="#C67C4E"/>
  <ellipse cx="264" cy="269" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#F6EBE4" opacity="0.48"/>
  <ellipse cx="198" cy="440" rx="90" ry="20" fill="#050505" opacity="0.4"/>
  <rect x="126" y="354" width="142" height="92" rx="20" fill="url(#cupFill)"/>
  <ellipse cx="197" cy="354" rx="71" ry="22" fill="#F9F2ED"/>
  <ellipse cx="197" cy="354" rx="57" ry="13" fill="#4E2920"/>
  <ellipse cx="197" cy="354" rx="43" ry="8" fill="#C67C4E"/>

  <line x1="170" y1="294" x2="160" y2="258" stroke="#F9F2ED" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.62"/>
  <line x1="198" y1="290" x2="198" y2="246" stroke="#F9F2ED" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.68"/>
  <line x1="225" y1="294" x2="237" y2="258" stroke="#F9F2ED" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.55"/>

  <!-- dark gradient overlay -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="792" fill="url(#heroShade)"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="24" y="28" font-family="Sora, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="318" y1="22" x2="318" y2="28" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="323" y1="19" x2="323" y2="28" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="328" y1="16" x2="328" y2="28" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="345" cy="23" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="340" y1="18" x2="350" y2="28" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="359" y="17" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="361" y="19" width="15" height="8" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="382" y="21" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- brand mark -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="82" r="18" fill="#C67C4E"/>
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="82" rx="7" ry="13" fill="#F9F2ED" transform="rotate(28 32 82)"/>
  <line x1="32" y1="71" x2="32" y2="93" stroke="#C67C4E" stroke-width="2" transform="rotate(28 32 82)"/>
  <text x="60" y="88" font-family="Urbanist, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">shop</text>

  <!-- top skip control -->
  <g>
    <rect x="309" y="68" width="58" height="32" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.18"/>
    <text x="338" y="89" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Sora, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Skip</text>
  </g>

  <!-- content -->
  <text x="24" y="603" font-family="Urbanist, sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Coffee for every</text>
  <text x="24" y="642" font-family="Urbanist, sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">moment.</text>
  <text x="24" y="675" font-family="Sora, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#F9F2ED">Discover your favorite blends, order ahead,</text>
  <text x="24" y="696" font-family="Sora, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#F9F2ED">and make every cup feel just right.</text>

  <!-- pagination -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="723" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="723" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.4"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="723" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- primary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="740" width="346" height="54" rx="20" fill="#050505" opacity="0.28"/>
    <rect x="22" y="736" width="346" height="54" rx="20" fill="#C67C4E"/>
    <text x="195" y="770" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Sora, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Get Started</text>
    <circle cx="337" cy="763" r="13" fill="#F9F2ED" opacity="0.22"/>
    <polyline points="333,758 338,763 333,768" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="794" width="390" height="50" fill="#242424"/>
  <g opacity="0.82">
    <polygon points="42,811 51,803 60,811 60,822 54,822 54,815 48,815 48,822 42,822" fill="#C67C4E"/>
    <text x="51" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Sora, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="600" fill="#C67C4E">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g opacity="0.58">
    <circle cx="138" cy="808" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="143" y1="813" x2="149" y2="819" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="138" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Sora, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Search</text>
  </g>
  <g opacity="0.58">
    <rect x="219" y="803" width="14" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="216" y1="806" x2="216" y2="820" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="237" y1="806" x2="237" y2="820" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="226" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Sora, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Orders</text>
  </g>
  <g opacity="0.58">
    <circle cx="322" cy="808" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="322" cy="805" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <ellipse cx="322" cy="815" rx="6" ry="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="322" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Sora, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <rect x="128" y="840" width="134" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
</svg>
